detail: 2014/2018/2022/2026 municipality office and event universes are complete at source-supported cycle counts. Official Statistics Iceland/Landskjörstjórn result tables remain the recovery source.

No direct municipal executive office emitted; Local Authorities Act provides council chair election and council hiring of executive manager.
Zero EP offices. Iceland is not an EU member.
President retained as directly popularly elected single-round plurality office; no runoff invented.
Official 2018 publication reports 167,622 votes cast on summary page; other Statistics Iceland release/table views may differ slightly. Source views remain distinct; no forced reconciliation.
